examples.en: The Internet makes life different.
examples.zh: 互联网让生活变得不同。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：inter 互相 + net 网，Internet 是互联网。

examples.en: Look up the word in your dictionary.
examples.zh: 在词典里查一下这个单词。

examples.en: I look up new words on the Internet.
Can you look up this word for me?
examples.zh: 你能帮我查一下这个词吗？

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：look 看 + up 向上，look up 是在词典或网上查阅。

examples.en: There was no star player on the team before.
examples.zh: 以前队里没有明星队员。

examples.en: She is a star in our class.
We see a bright star at night.
examples.zh: 夜晚我们看到一颗明亮的星星。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：star 音近「斯达」，star 是星、明星。
语义联想：She is a star in our class. star 是星、明星。

examples.en: Long ago, there was no Internet at school.
examples.zh: 很久以前，学校没有网络。

examples.en: I met her two years ago.
Life was different twenty years ago.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：ago 音近「阿 go」，long ago 是很久以前。
语义联想：Long ago, there was no Internet at school. ago 是……以前。

examples.en: We eat lunch in the dining hall.
The dining hall is bigger than before.
There was no dining hall at school long ago.
examples.zh: 很久以前学校没有食堂。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：dining 用餐 + hall 大厅，dining hall 是食堂。

examples.en: There is green grass on the playground.
We sat on the grass and talked.
Do not walk on the grass.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：grass 音近「格拉斯」，grass 是草。
形象联想：想象 grass 操场上绿绿的草坪。

examples.en: We have PE class in the gym.
examples.zh: 我们在体育馆上体育课。

examples.en: The gym is on the first floor.
There was no gym at our school before.
examples.zh: 以前我们学校没有体育馆。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：gym 音近「吉姆」，gym 是体育馆。
形象联想：想象 gym 室内打 badminton 或做运动。

examples.en: She is very active in class.
Stay active and you will feel better.
examples.zh: 保持活跃你会感觉更好。

examples.en: We have more active sports now.
examples.zh: 我们现在有更多活跃的运动项目。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：act 行动 + ive，active 是活跃的。

examples.en: School is different from before.
We live in a different time now.
examples.zh: 我们现在生活在不同的时代。

examples.en: My life feels different this year.
examples.zh: 今年我的生活感觉不一样了。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：differ 不同 + ent，different 是不同的。

examples.en: We play badminton in the gym.
examples.zh: 我们在体育馆打羽毛球。

examples.en: Badminton is my favourite sport.
examples.zh: 羽毛球是我最喜欢的运动。

examples.en: There was no badminton class before.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 badminton 羽毛球在 gym 里飞来飞去。

examples.en: Cycling is good exercise.
examples.zh: 骑自行车是很好的锻炼。

examples.en: I enjoy cycling after school.
examples.zh: 我喜欢放学后骑自行车。

examples.en: There was no cycling club long ago.
examples.zh: 很久以前没有自行车社团。

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 cycling 骑车穿过公园。

examples.en: We go cycling on Sundays.
examples.zh: 我们星期天去骑自行车。

examples.en: Let us go cycling in the park.
examples.zh: 我们去公园骑自行车吧。

examples.en: He went cycling with his friends yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天他和朋友去骑自行车了。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：go 去 + cycling 骑车，go cycling 是去骑自行车。

examples.en: I can ice-skate in winter.
We ice-skate on the lake.
She learned to ice-skate last year.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：ice 冰 + skate 滑，ice-skate 是滑冰。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 ice-skates；过去式 ice-skated

examples.en: The cheetah runs faster than a lion.
I read about the cheetah in a magazine.
examples.zh: 我在杂志里读到了猎豹。

examples.en: The cheetah is the fastest animal on land.
examples.zh: 猎豹是陆地上跑得最快的动物。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：cheetah 音近「奇塔」，cheetah 是猎豹。
形象联想：想象 cheetah 在 race 里跑得飞快。

examples.en: I had a dream about the cheetah.
examples.zh: 我做了一个关于猎豹的梦。

examples.en: She woke up from a bad dream.
Follow your dream and stay active.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：dream 音近「追姆」，dream 是梦。
形象联想：想象 dream 梦见 cheetah 在跑 race。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 dreams；过去式 dreamed/dreamt

examples.en: I felt happy after the race.
He felt tired but active.
We felt nothing could stop us.
examples.zh: 我们觉得没有什么能阻挡我们。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：I felt happy after the race. felt 是 feel 的过去式，感到。

reveal.inflectionNote: feel 的过去式；第三人称单数 feels

examples.en: There was nothing on the grass before.
examples.zh: 以前草地上什么都没有。

examples.en: I thought about nothing but the dream.
Nothing is impossible if you try.
examples.zh: 只要努力，没有什么不可能。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：no 没有 + thing 东西，nothing 是没有东西、什么也没有。

examples.en: We had a race on the playground.
examples.zh: 我们在操场上进行了赛跑。

examples.en: The cheetah won the race easily.
Who won the race yesterday?

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：race 音近「瑞斯」，race 是赛跑。
语义联想：We had a race on the playground. race 是赛跑。

examples.en: I thought school was boring before.
examples.zh: 以前我觉得学校很无聊。

examples.en: She thought the race was easy.
We thought life was different long ago.
examples.zh: 我们觉得很久以前生活不一样。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：I thought school was boring before. thought 是 think 的过去式，认为。

reveal.inflectionNote: think 的过去式；第三人称单数 thinks

examples.en: Be careful! Do not trip on the grass.
I trip over a stone.
Do not trip at the race.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 trip 被石头绊一下差点摔倒。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 trips；过去式 tripped

examples.en: I woke up early this morning.
She woke from a strange dream.
examples.zh: 她从一场奇怪的梦里醒来。

examples.en: We woke before the sun rose.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 woke 闹钟响后从 dream 里醒来。

reveal.inflectionNote: wake 的过去式；第三人称单数 wakes
